SUBJECT : EC5201 DIGITAL COMMUNICATION SYSTEM

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: V

SUBJECT : EC5201 DIGITAL COMMUNICATION SYSTEM

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Justify that the randomness is the essence of a communication system.  [2]
 (b) Distinguish between discrete, continuous and mixed type of random variable and plot
their Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF).
[3]


Q2 (a) State the properties of the PDF of a random variable.  [2]
 (b) A loaded die produces the numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 with probabilities 0.10, 0.12, 0.12,
0.14, 0.20 and 0.32 respectively. Find the mean and variance.
[3]


Q3 (a) Classify the stationary random processes. [2]
 (b) Show that the random process X(t) = A cos(ωt + θ) where θ is uniformly distributed over
–π to π, is ergodic in mean and autocorrelation.

[3]


Q4 (a) Plot the power spectral density of the white process. Why the white process is called
white noise?
[2]
 (b) Determine the power spectrum of the processes X(t) = A cos(ωt + θ) where θ is uniformly
distributed over –π to π.
[3]


Q5 (a) Explain the significance of quantization noise. [2]
 (b) A PCM system uses a uniform quantizer followed by a 7-bit encoder. The bit rate of the
system  is  equal  to  50X10
6
  bits  per  second.  What  is  the  maximum  message  signal
bandwidth for which the system operates satisfactorily?
[3]


Q6 (a) Discuss how the granular noise distortion can be reduced in Delta modulation? [2]
 (b) A DM transmitter with a fixed step of 0.5 V, is given a sinusoidal message signal. If the
sampling frequency is 20 times the Nyquist rate, determine the maximum permissible
amplitude of the message signal, if slope overload is to be avoided.
[3]
